<thought>Based on the exact mass (127.0997) the molecular formula is C7H13NO. The ¹H NMR shows three singlets integrating to 3 H, 6 H and 3 H, consistent with four methyl groups (one of them appearing as two equivalent methyls) and a non‑protonated heteroatom (the NH proton is exchangeable and not observed). This pattern fits an N‑acetyl‑tert‑butylamine (CH₃‑C(=O)‑NH‑C(CH₃)₃). The SMILES for this structure is “CC(C)(C)NC(=O)C”. This SMILES is valid and matches the formula C7H13NO.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(C)(C)NC(=O)C</final_answer>
